verse.verse_1: The craving for excess wealth kept you people neglectful.
verse.verse_3: Yes certainly, you will soon realise!
verse.verse_4: Again, yes certainly, you will soon realise!
verse.verse_5: Yes certainly, if you had believed with certainty, you would not have craved for wealth.
verse.verse_7: Again, indeed you will see it with certainty.
verse.verse_8: Then, on that day, you will surely be questioned regarding the favours.
